requests.assessment: Angular viewer; main JS has _urlPhpRoot and _urlMapServ

WFS caps for PUDI_antananarivo.map; FeatureTypes plof_atsimondrano_1/2, plof_avaradrano_1/2, __plof_*_plof, tana_os_*, EPSG:3857
3 closed Polygon features (~630-3100 m2), geometry only, no attributes/IDs; located ~9 km S/SE of the city centre point

bounded query at the city centre point returned no parcel polygon there (PLOF layers cover only zones outside the centre)

notes: Found via viewer inspection: a public MapServer WFS (Observatoire du Territoire) serves PLOF (Plan Local d'Occupation Fonciere) polygons for parts of Antananarivo Avaradrano/Atsimondrano/Laniera. Polygon sizes are parcel-like but layers carry no attributes or IDs and their cadastral meaning is unconfirmed, so not counted as verified parcels; nothing at the city centre point. Terms not read. The MAP value is a server-side path handed out by the viewer's own public ajax call (not saved here). Other .mg hosts fail at tunnel level, cause unproven.
nextStep: Confirm PLOF layer semantics with the operator; check tana_os_* layers for attributes; read terms.
